QUOTE: It is `forwardRef<SearchRef, Props>` (line 53). It doesn't use the ref itself. When `hasSearch` is true, it renders `<NavigationSearch ... ref={ref} />` (line 134).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says NavigationHeader forwards its ref to NavigationSearch only when `hasSearch` is true. The "attached to nothing" consequence is implied, since the ref is not used elsewhere and the other screens default `hasSearch` to false.
